# Obed Abernethy

## Overview

- **Age:** Sixty years old at the beginning of the series  <sub>[v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023), [v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002)</sub>
- **Status:** Deceased  <sub>[v1 c37 P1](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0001), [v1 c37 P9](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0009)</sub>
- **Origin:** Brierley, St. Brendan’s Island  <sub>[v1 c1 P0](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0000), [v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002), [v1 c1 P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006)</sub>
- **Role:** Farmer  <sub>[v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002), [v1 c3 P30](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0030)</sub>

## Appearance

He has an awkward frame with hunching shoulders and lengthy iron-gray hair reaching down to his back. He has maintained a thick, gentle brown beard continuously from the age of twenty, which has grayed slightly over time. He often carries a bashful, timid expression that softens into a pleased grin when he is contented.

_Sources: [v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003), [v1 c6 P32](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0032), [v1 c9 P4](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0004)_

## Personality

He is extremely bashful, quiet, and taciturn, preferring to avoid unfamiliar people and company. He holds a deep fear of women, with few exceptions, believing they secretly mock his unusual appearance. Despite his extreme shyness, he possesses a soft, sympathetic heart and a quiet stubbornness once his mind is made up.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P4](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0004), [v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003), [v1 c2 P27](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0027), [v1 c2 P74](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0074), [v1 c4 P21](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0021)_

## Traits

- Extremely bashful and timid  <sub>[v1 c1 P4](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0004), [v1 c2 P27](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0027)</sub>
- Fear of unfamiliar women  <sub>[v1 c1 P4](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0004), [v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003)</sub>
- Taciturn and quiet  <sub>[v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002), [v1 c2 P27](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0027)</sub>
- Soft-hearted and compassionate  <sub>[v1 c2 P74](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0074), [v1 c4 P26](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0026), [v1 c10 P3](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0003)</sub>
- Quietly stubborn  <sub>[v1 c1 P27](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0027), [v1 c4 P21](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0021), [v1 c10 P13](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0013)</sub>

## Abilities

- Farming and agricultural work  <sub>[v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002), [v1 c3 P30](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0030), [v1 c16 P15](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0015)</sub>

## Goals

- To secure help for farm work and provide a good home for an orphan child  <sub>[v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023), [v1 c3 P60](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0060)</sub>

## History

He lived at Grey Shutters in Brierley with his sister Thirza, working his farm. Needing help due to advancing age, he agreed to adopt a young Canadian orphan boy. When he went to Alder River station, he discovered that a mistake had been made and an orphan girl, Nell Harcourt, was sent instead. Unable to leave her stranded, he brought her home and quietly advocated for keeping her. He developed a strong bond with Nell, frequently supporting her and purchasing gifts for her. After suffering from worsening heart trouble, he collapsed and died upon learning that the bank holding his life savings had failed. He was buried in the local Brierley cemetery, remembered with deep affection by his household.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006), [v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023), [v1 c2 P7](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0007), [v1 c2 P17](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0017), [v1 c3 P61](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0061), [v1 c12 P42](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0042), [v1 c25 P33](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0033), [v1 c30 P38](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0038), [v1 c37 P1](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0001), [v1 c37 P9](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0009), [v1 c37 P11](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0011)_

## Background by volume

- Raised in Grey Shutters by a bashful father who built the farmstead far back from the thoroughfare  <sub>[v1 c1 P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006), [v1 c1 P31](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0031)</sub>
- Suffered from heart trouble in his old age  <sub>[v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023), [v1 c30 P38](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0038)</sub>
